turns.prompt_text: I'd like to play soccer. Is there any teams in Ames Iowa where I a 27-year-old male can play?
turns.response_html:
You have a few solid options right here in Ames for adult soccer, ranging from structured league play to casual, year-round pickup games.

1. Ames Parks and Recreation Adult CoEd League

The city runs an organized 8-on-8 Coed Adult League during the summer (typically running from late May through July/August).

  • The Setup: Games are played on Sunday afternoons and Wednesday evenings at the North River Valley (NRV) Park fields. They offer two levels: Division 1 for competitive play and Division 2 for recreation.
  • How to Join: Registration is technically by team, but they maintain an official Individual Player Pool. You can register your name and contact info online, and team managers use this list to pick up free agents when they need extra legs.

2. Ames Hurricanes (Via Ames Soccer Club & Nevada Rec)

The Ames Hurricanes is a long-running collective of men's, women's, and coed adult teams in the area. They offer a mix of local pickup and league play that runs practically all year.

  • Outdoor Season (April – October): They host outdoor games on Wednesday evenings at the Hunziker Soccer Complex in Ames.
  • Indoor Season (November – March): They move indoors on Wednesday evenings to the Nevada Fieldhouse (just a 15-minute drive east of Ames) for players 18 and older. They also run Sunday morning indoor slots, though those lean toward the 35+ crowd.
  • How to Join: All experience levels are welcome. You can find their schedule details through the Ames Soccer Club resource page or sign up for indoor sessions via the Nevada Parks and Recreation portal (which uses a "Hurricane Soccer Pass").

3. Central Iowa Coed Soccer (CICS)

If you don't mind a short drive down I-35 for games, CICS is the massive adult rec league serving the greater Des Moines area.

  • The Setup: They run distinct Spring (April–June) and Fall (September–October) seasons. Because of their size, they have a lot of vertical divisions, meaning you can easily find a team that perfectly matches your preferred competitive intensity.

💡 Next Step: Since summer leagues are currently mid-season, hitting up the Ames Hurricanes for their Wednesday night outdoor pickup at Hunziker is your fastest way to get on the pitch, meet local players, and get recruited for the upcoming fall or indoor seasons.

turns.prompt_text: What are the official registration websites or contact emails for the Ames Parks & Rec player pool and the Ames Hurricanes?
turns.response_html:
Here is the direct contact and registration information you need to get connected with both groups.

1. Ames Parks & Recreation Player Pool

Because the summer league is currently running (June through August), you can submit your details directly to the city's individual player database so team captains looking for players can contact you.

  • Official Website / Portal: City of Ames Adult Sports & Leagues
  • Direct Soccer Page: Ames Parks & Rec Adult Soccer
  • General Inquiries Email: amesparkrec@cityofames.org
  • Phone: 515-239-5350
  • Note: To submit your info online via the "Player Pool Registration" link on their soccer page, you may need to request a quick, free Household ID if you don't already have a city recreation account.

2. Ames Hurricanes Soccer Club

The Hurricanes operate as an independent non-profit club managing several coed, men's, and women's teams across local play and regional leagues.

  • Official Website: Ames Hurricanes Soccer Club
  • Contact & Join Form: They use a direct web-based communication form for prospective players at Ames Hurricanes Contact Us.
  • Club Infrastructure: If you are looking for their specific outdoor turf/field location or winter pass tie-ins, they coordinate closely with the Ames Soccer Club staff (gary.eyles@amessoccer.org or nick.kyras@amessoccer.org).

⚽ Recommendation: Drop a quick message through the Ames Hurricanes contact form letting them know your age, experience level, and that you're looking to jump into their Wednesday evening open slots or get on a roster. They are typically very responsive to local players looking for a home team.
